name: Life Regen Charm
description: Adds '+N% of Max Life as Replenish Life' to Large Charms: three suffix tiers for magic Large Charms, plus a unique Large Charm that Gheed can sell. Overflow-safe up to a total of about 6,394% at 8,191 max life.
author: Latedozer

children.name: Round up
children.description: The game always rounds down. This adds +1 Replenish Life to every charm to act like rounding up.

config.name: Tier 1 suffix
config.description: Untick to stop this tier from spawning. Charms you already own keep working.

children.name: Suffix name
children.description: Shown on the charm, e.g. 'Large Charm of Renewal'.

children.name: Item level
children.description: Minimum item level for this suffix to spawn.

children.name: Required level
children.description: Character level needed to use the charm.

children.name: Frequency
children.description: Spawn weight versus other suffixes (vanilla charm suffixes are mostly 1-4).

config.name: Tier 2 suffix
config.description: Untick to stop this tier from spawning. Charms you already own keep working.

config.name: Tier 3 suffix
config.description: Untick to stop this tier from spawning. Charms you already own keep working.

config.name: Unique charm
config.description: The unique always exists so charms you own stay valid; these settings change its name, value and whether Gheed sells it.

children.name: Sold by Gheed
children.description: Gheed (Act 1) always stocks the unique Large Charm.
